Hostess Brands, Inc. (TWNK) EPS Estimated At $0.15; Ivory Investment Management LP Cut Anthem (ANTM) Position 
January 11, 2018 - By Maria Brooks 
Analysts expect Hostess Brands, Inc. (NASDAQ:TWNK) to report $0.15 EPS on February, 14.TWNK’s profit would be $19.56 million giving it 24.83 P/E if the $0.15 EPS is correct. After having $0.09 EPS previously, Hostess Brands, Inc.’s analysts see 66.67% EPS growth. The stock decreased 0.37% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $14.9. About 111,399 shares traded. Hostess Brands, Inc. (NASDAQ:TWNK) has risen 69.90% since January 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 53.20% the S&P500. 
Ivory Investment Management Lp decreased Anthem Inc (ANTM) stake by 47.68% reported in 2017Q3 SEC filing. Ivory Investment Management Lp sold 186,414 shares as Anthem Inc (ANTM)’s stock rose 10.08%. The Ivory Investment Management Lp holds 204,554 shares with $38.84M value, down from 390,968 last quarter. Anthem Inc now has $60.47B valuation. The stock increased 0.68% or $1.6 during the last trading session, reaching $235.49. About 429,525 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 31.86% since January 11, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 15.16% the S&P500. 
Among 24 analysts covering Anthem Inc ( NYSE:ANTM ), 13 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 11 Hold. Therefore 54% are positive. Anthem Inc had 63 analyst reports since July 27, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Equal-Weight” rating and $215 target in Thursday, October 26 report. The rating was maintained by Cantor Fitzgerald with “Buy” on Wednesday, October 18. The firm has “Overweight” rating by Cantor Fitzgerald given on Friday, April 28. Cantor Fitzgerald maintained Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) rating on Thursday, September 14. Cantor Fitzgerald has “Buy” rating and $215.0 target. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Sterne Agee CRT on Tuesday, May 24. JP Morgan downgraded the stock to “Neutral” rating in Monday, October 17 report. The stock has “Hold” rating by Jefferies on Friday, August 18. On Friday, November 17 the stock rating was maintained by Bank of America with “Buy”. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank on Thursday, July 13 with “Hold”. The company was maintained on Tuesday, November 7 by Leerink Swann. 
Analysts await Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) to report earnings on February, 7. They expect $1.25 EPS, down 28.98% or $0.51 from last year’s $1.76 per share. ANTM’s profit will be $320.95 million for 47.10 P/E if the $1.25 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.65 actual EPS reported by Anthem, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -52.83% negative EPS growth. 
Ivory Investment Management Lp increased Mellanox Technologies Ltd (NASDAQ:MLNX) stake by 31,207 shares to 213,572 valued at $10.07M in 2017Q3. It also upped Kraft Heinz Co stake by 100,855 shares and now owns 525,236 shares. Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) was raised too. 
Hostess Brands, Inc., a packaged food company, focuses on developing, manufacturing, marketing, selling, and distributing fresh sweet baked goods in the United States. The company has market cap of $1.94 billion. The firm operates in two divisions, Sweet Baked Goods and Other. It currently has negative earnings. The Company’s principal product lines include Twinkies, Zingers, Donettes, coffee cakes, cupcakes, cinnamon rolls, Ding Dongs, honey buns, fruit pies, Sno Balls, mini muffins, Chocodiles, Ho Hos, brownies, Suzy Qs, bread and buns, danishes, jumbo muffins, iced cookies, eclairs, and madeleines. 
Among 8 analysts covering Hostess Brands ( NASDAQ:TWNK ), 4 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. Hostess Brands had 12 analyst reports since February 14, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating by RBC Capital Markets given on Monday, September 18. The company was initiated on Wednesday, October 11 by J.P. Morgan. As per Monday, July 31, the company rating was initiated by UBS. The rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, November 9 with “Equal-Weight”. The rating was downgraded by UBS to “Sell” on Friday, October 13. On Friday, October 13 the stock rating was maintained by Stephens with “Buy”. The stock of Hostess Brands, Inc. (NASDAQ:TWNK) earned “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank on Wednesday, February 15. As per Wednesday, October 25, the company rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets.
